summary: Bob's Discount Furniture filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its revolving credit facility. BDF Acquisition Corp., a subsidiary, entered into a joinder agreement and amendment increasing total commitments from $125 million to $200 million, with an option to upsize by another $50 million, and extended the maturity from July 1, 2029 to April 29, 2031. New lenders were added, borrowing base formulas updated to include cash and cash equivalents subject to control agreements. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are present.
